summary.zh-CN: PagerDuty 官方远程 MCP，查询事件、服务与值班排班，并可更新事件（如确认）。托管服务的 API Key 须以 Token 头传入，Teloa 目前只支持 Bearer，因此需填写 Scoped OAuth 应用经 client-credentials 获取的访问令牌。数据经由 pagerduty.com 传输。
summary.en: PagerDuty official remote MCP: query incidents, services and on-call schedules, and update incidents (e.g. acknowledge). The hosted server expects API keys in a Token header while Teloa only sends Bearer, so enter an access token issued to a Scoped OAuth app via client credentials. Data transits pagerduty.com.

label.zh-CN: PagerDuty OAuth 访问令牌（Scoped OAuth 应用经 client-credentials 获取；REST API Key 不可用）
label.en: PagerDuty OAuth access token (from a Scoped OAuth app via client credentials; REST API keys do not work)

description.zh-CN: 列出与查看 Incident、告警与备注
description.en: List and view incidents, alerts and notes

description.zh-CN: 创建或更新 Incident（含确认、加备注）
description.en: Create or update incidents (including acknowledge and notes)

conditions.zh-CN: 托管服务的 API Key 只收 Authorization: Token token=…，Teloa 以 Bearer 传入，须改用 Scoped OAuth 应用的访问令牌；令牌过期后需重新填写
conditions.en: The hosted server accepts API keys only as Authorization: Token token=…; Teloa sends Bearer, so use an access token from a Scoped OAuth app and re-enter it when it expires

conditions.zh-CN: 托管服务不支持工具过滤，可用 Scoped OAuth 应用的权限收窄可成功调用的工具
conditions.en: The hosted server has no tool filtering; narrow what can succeed through the Scoped OAuth app permissions

conditions.zh-CN: 数据经由 pagerduty.com 平台传输
